routing_cases.state: Prove totalFrom acc xs = acc + xs.sum. The fixed direct catalog may use local hypotheses, simplification, arithmetic, and ordinary induction, but cannot generalize acc.
routing_cases.declaration: example (acc : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : JevLean.totalFrom acc xs = acc + xs.sum := by
routing_cases.helper_patch:
private lemma route_totalFrom (acc : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : JevLean.totalFrom acc xs = acc + xs.sum := by
  induction xs generalizing acc <;> simp_all [JevLean.totalFrom] <;> omega
example (acc : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : JevLean.totalFrom acc xs = acc + xs.sum := by exact route_totalFrom acc xs

routing_cases.state: Prove mirror (mirror t) = t. The direct catalog excludes structural induction; a reusable involution helper is offered as a separate patch.
routing_cases.declaration: example (t : JevLean.Tree Nat) : JevLean.Tree.mirror (JevLean.Tree.mirror t) = t := by
routing_cases.helper_patch:
private lemma route_mirror (t : JevLean.Tree Nat) : JevLean.Tree.mirror (JevLean.Tree.mirror t) = t := by
  induction t <;> simp_all [JevLean.Tree.mirror]
example (t : JevLean.Tree Nat) : JevLean.Tree.mirror (JevLean.Tree.mirror t) = t := by exact route_mirror t

routing_cases.state: Prove tally distributes over append. The direct catalog excludes induction; an auxiliary structural theorem can be added.
routing_cases.declaration: example (xs ys : List Nat) : JevLean.tally (xs ++ ys) = JevLean.tally xs + JevLean.tally ys := by
routing_cases.helper_patch:
private lemma route_tally (xs ys : List Nat) : JevLean.tally (xs ++ ys) = JevLean.tally xs + JevLean.tally ys := by
  induction xs <;> simp_all [JevLean.tally, Nat.add_assoc]
example (xs ys : List Nat) : JevLean.tally (xs ++ ys) = JevLean.tally xs + JevLean.tally ys := by exact route_tally xs ys
